chunks: From him, from his father, from Abu Abdillah al-Barqi, from Bakr ibn Muhammad, from Khaythama, who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'Whoever drinks as-sawiq for forty mornings, his shoulders will be filled with strength.'

key_terms.أَرْبَعِينَ صَبَاحاً: For forty mornings; a specific duration often used in medical and spiritual traditions for establishing habits or cures.
key_terms.السَّوِيق: A traditional food made from roasted flour, often mixed with water, oil, or honey; a type of flour soup or porridge.
key_terms.كَتِفَاهُ: His shoulders; referring to the upper body strength and physical robustness.

ai.seo_question: What are the benefits of drinking Suweq for forty mornings according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in *Al-Kafi* by Al-Barqi, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) underscores the Shia emphasis on *al-tibb al-nabawi* (Prophetic medicine), linking specific dietary regimens to physical vitality. The forty-day duration suggests a sustained therapeutic cycle, reflecting the holistic view in Shia tradition where bodily strength supports spiritual devotion. This practice exemplifies the principle that maintaining health is an act of worship when done with the intention of preserving the body as an amanah (trust) from God.

en.hubeali: From him, from his father, from Abu Abdullah Al Barqy, from Bakr Bin Muhammad, from Khasheyma who said,
‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The one who drinks Al-Suweyq for forty mornings, his shoulders would be filled with strength’.
en.sarwar: 12. It is narrated from the narrator of the previous Hadith from his father from abu ‘Abd Allah, al-Barqiy from Bakr ibn Muhammad from Khaythamah who has said the following: “
If one drinks sawiq for forty mornings his shoulder will fill up with strength.’”
